subject: general

question: Which state/UT constructed 3,300 km of rural roads in 2020-21 under the Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jammu and Kashmir**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Jammu & Kashmir constructed 3,300 km of rural roads in 2020-21 under the Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana.
 
• Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana scheme was launched by the** Ministry of Rural Development**.
 
• It was introduced in the year **2000** by then Prime Minister of India **Late Atal Bihari Vajpayee**.
 
• The Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY), was launched by the Govt. of India to provide connectivity to unconnected Habitations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
